netflix.title: Who Is Martin Mull?
netflix.overview: Discover Martin Mull's restless reinvention from smoky folk clubs to primetime sitcoms to gallery walls, told in his own words and by the friends who watched it happen, including Steve Martin, Tom Waits, David Alan Grier and others.

netflix.title: AlMahaitiya
netflix.overview: A wealthy family loses their fortune and chooses to continue to fake affluence in an effort to keep up appearances.

amazon-prime-video.title: Love of Your Life
amazon-prime-video.overview: After a chance encounter sparks a sweeping romance, Maya's future is suddenly upended, sending her on an unexpected journey to love and live again.

amazon-prime-video.title: I Would Rather Die
amazon-prime-video.overview: One cold night, misfit Archie gets bitten by a zombie and after briefly considering ending his life, he decides he's going to figure out what the hell is happening to his body. So, with the help of his only friend and his lifelong crush, Archie sets out to find a cure before he turns into a full-blown monster and kills everyone.

apple-tv.title: Tenzing
apple-tv.overview: The untold and inspiring tale of one of the most important mountain climbers in history who, with Edmund Hillary, became the first person to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

apple-tv.title: Matchbox the Movie
apple-tv.overview: When a group of former childhood friends reconnect, their reunion takes a wild turn as they stumble upon a dangerous international plot—and must save the world.

apple-tv.title: The Last First: Winter K2
apple-tv.overview: K2's first winter ascent claimed 5 lives, revealing modern alpinism's struggles with commercialization, social media impact, and conflicts between marginalized climbers and traditional elites.

disney-plus.title: Phony
disney-plus.overview: After waking up from a freak car accident, Sonny discovers that his mother has been replaced by an impostor.

hayu.title: Vanderpump Rules: Lisa Las Vegas
hayu.overview: Follow Lisa Vanderpump as she opens The Vanderpump Hotel (formerly The Cromwell) on the Las Vegas Strip in partnership with Caesars Entertainment

hayu.title: War
hayu.overview: Two top London law firms clash over a shocking divorce case that rocks the legal world, with elite attorneys from Cathcarts and Taylor and Byrne battling for supremacy.

hayu.title: Still Flipping Out
hayu.overview: Follows Lewis as he navigates the hilariously unpredictable nature of his professional and personal lives as his trademark spontaneity collides with the people who work with him, for him, and still somehow survive him.

hbo-max.title: Corregidora: The Darkest Night in Mexican Soccer
hbo-max.overview: Revisits the events of March 5, 2022, during the match between Querétaro and Atlas, reconstructing what unfolded and examining its aftermath, the conflicting narratives surrounding the case, and the questions that, four years later, remain unresolved.

bloodstream.title: Tag
bloodstream.overview: On their honeymoon in a quaint, old-fashioned town, newlyweds Maggie and Joe decide to ignore a local warning and venture into a supposedly haunted maze after dark. After a few drinks, the couple turns their late-night adventure into a playful game of tag. But as they wander deeper into the winding paths, their innocent fun takes an unsettling turn. With darkness closing in and strange things happening around them, the newlyweds begin to realize they may not be alone. And in this maze, some games are better left unplayed.

bloodstream.title: Last Chance Motel
bloodstream.overview: A newlywed couple's dream wedding spirals into a bloody nightmare when they uncover that their secluded venue- a desolate motel deep in the Nevada desert- is run by a relentless bloodthirsty family with dark secrets, revealing that one bride's future may not be all that it was promised to be.

crunchyroll-amazon-channel.title: Full Clearing Another World Under a Goddess with Zero Believers
crunchyroll-amazon-channel.overview: An isekai fantasy where an ordinary gamer reincarnates without special powers, teams up with a minor goddess, and rises from the weakest to the strongest in a new world.

crunchyroll-amazon-channel.title: HORROR COLLECTOR
crunchyroll-amazon-channel.overview: Not all urban legends are myths. Some are real, and they’re coming to life. Fushigi roams Japan in a red hood, sealing them inside his magical notebook, with Jimmy, his human-faced dog, by his side. Each phenomenon brings him one step closer to capturing Himitsu, the girl responsible for manifesting the supernatural beings.

crunchyroll-amazon-channel.title: From Far Away
crunchyroll-amazon-channel.overview: Noriko is an ordinary high school student, until an explosion pulls her into a world of magic where no one speaks her language. Completely lost, Noriko is rescued by Izark, a shunned swordsman determined to kill the Awakening: a prophesied figure said to control the Sky Demon. As Izark and Noriko bond, he realizes she may be the very person he’s hunting.

crunchyroll-amazon-channel.title: FX Fighter Kurumi-chan
crunchyroll-amazon-channel.overview: Student Kurumi Fukuga starts FX trading to recover her late mother's 20 million yen loss. She discovers a volatile world of gains and losses. With friends Mochiko, Mebuki and Yasuko, she navigates this risky money game's highs and lows.
